rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
optative passive expressing that cutting does not take effect
compound indicating absorption or attainment of that state
possessive compound indicating one whose mind is directed to that

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed when subjected to cutting?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to the act of cutting.
A person can be absorbed in that higher state.
A person can have the mind fixed entirely on that state.
items.inference: One absorbed in that state with mind fixed on it remains unharmed despite being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that state and whose mind is fixed on it is not truly cut.
